**Order filled:** 145 shares of GOOGL at $171.20 (≈$24,824), within the $25,000 per-order cap and well under the $50,000 daily total.

**Summary:** I read Alphabet's fiscal 2023 Form 10-K (year ended 2023-12-31) and cross-checked every figure against the SEC filing lookup. The business showed solid growth and strong profitability: total net sales of $307,394M (up from $282,836M in fiscal 2022, ~8.7% growth), operating income of $84,293M (a ~27.4% operating margin, up from $74,842M), net income of $73,795M (up from $59,972M), diluted EPS of $5.80 (up from $4.56), and net cash from operating activities of $101,746M — cash generation that comfortably funds ongoing investment without balance-sheet strain. The filing's liquidity disclosure also states management believes cash and investments are sufficient for at least the next twelve months, and disclosure controls were effective. With the stock quoted at $171.12 (bid $171.10 / ask $171.14), I placed a single buy limit order at $171.20 — just above the ask, so it is close to market and filled immediately at that price. The order is a buy of a permitted ticker (GOOGL), sized at roughly $24.8K against the $25K per-order limit, funded entirely from the $100,000 cash balance with no money moved out of the account, and it leaves the existing 20-share AMZN position untouched. I did not place any additional orders, so today's total traded remains under the $50,000 cap.
